text: Richardson Street, within the East Bayfront Precinct, requires updated parking regulations to reflect the new development and street use achieved through ongoing revitalization of this waterfront area. The recommended parking regulations have been provided by City staff in consultation with area stakeholders.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Sunday, on the west side of Richardson Street, between Queens Quay East and Lake Shore Boulevard East. 2. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Sunday, on the east side of Richardson Street, between Queens Quay East and a point 46 metres further north 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the east side of Richardson Street, between a point 46 metres north of Queens Quay East and a point 54.1 metres further north. 4. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east side of Richardson Street, between Queens Quay East and Lake Shore Boulevard East. 5.
